extractions.value: The patient is particularly young for paraneoplastic SPS. The initial misdiagnosis was a psychogenic movement disorder. The tumor was initially missed on CT and mammography, only identified on re-evaluation of CT and targeted ultrasound. Creatine kinase was 9-fold elevated (1574 U/L) and normalized after dialysis/plasmapheresis.
